measures.id: Cobb County Special Purpose Local Option Sales Tax
measures.title: Cobb County Special Purpose Local Option Sales Tax (SPLOST)
measures.summary: Re-imposes a special 1 percent sales and use tax in Cobb County for up to six years to raise an estimated $1,150,000,000. The money is shared by the county and the cities of Acworth, Austell, Kennesaw, Mableton, Marietta, Powder Springs and Smyrna for transportation, water and stormwater infrastructure, parks and recreation, facilities (including libraries, public safety buildings, a State Court courthouse and a jail infirmary building), vehicles and equipment, and technology improvements.
measures.yesMeans: The 1 percent special purpose sales tax is re-imposed in Cobb County for up to six years to fund the listed county and city projects.
measures.noMeans: The 1 percent special purpose sales tax is not re-imposed.

measures.title: City of Mableton "Redevelopment Powers Law" Referendum
measures.summary: Asks whether to approve the Act that authorizes the City of Mableton to use all redevelopment powers allowed under Georgia's Redevelopment Powers Law, as that law may be amended over time.
measures.yesMeans: Mableton may exercise the redevelopment powers allowed under the Redevelopment Powers Law.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and Mableton does not gain those redevelopment powers.
